'''Resistance Is Futile''' is the 10th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 22 November 2011. The set consists of 18 cards. This set is part of the ''Life from Lifelessness block'' consisting of cards from [[Life From Lifelessness (expansion)|Life From Lifelessness]], [[Straight and Steady (expansion)|Straight and Steady]], [[BaH! (expansion)|BaH!]], [[Shades of Gray (expansion)|Shades of Gray]], and [[Resistance Is Futile (expansion)|Resistance Is Futile]] virtual expansions.
